stem: What happens next in this passage after “Cooking required more time and physical work.”?
options: Students compared old maps with current ones.
Students compared it with modern digital scales.
Students compared them with modern plastic bottles.
Students compared it with their own kitchens.

本文沒有陳述「Students compared it with modern digital scales.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students compared them with modern plastic bottles.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Cooking required more time and physical work. Students compared it with their own kitchens.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
